question: Which Batsmen has the highest batting average against Australia in T20 history?
query: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.batting_team != 'Australia' AND (m.team1 = 'Australia' OR m.team2 = 'Australia')
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(d.runs_scored * 1.0) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which bowler has the best economy rate in overs 17-20 across all T20 World Cups, with a minimum of 100 balls bowled in that phase?
query: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
    AND m.stage IN ('Group', 'Semi Final', 'Final')
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING 
    SUM(d.extra_runs) IS NOT NULL 
    AND COUNT(d.delivery_id) >= 100
ORDER BY 
    CAST(SUM(d.extra_runs + d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) * 6 / COUNT(d.delivery_id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I à¨µà¨¿à©±à¨š, 10 à¨œà¨¾à¨‚ à¨µà©±à¨§ à¨µà¨¿à¨•à¨Ÿà¨¾à¨‚ à¨²à©ˆà¨£ à¨µà¨¾à¨²à©‡ à¨—à©‡à¨‚à¨¦à¨¬à¨¾à¨œà¨¼à¨¾à¨‚ à¨µà¨¿à©±à¨šà©‹à¨‚ à¨•à¨¿à¨¸à¨¦à©€ à¨¸à¨­ à¨¤à©‹à¨‚ à¨µà¨§à©€à¨† à¨”à¨¸à¨¤ à¨¹à©ˆ, à¨…à¨¤à©‡ à¨‰à¨¨à©à¨¹à¨¾à¨‚ à¨¦à©€ à¨‡à¨•à¨¾à¨¨à¨®à©€ à¨…à¨¤à©‡ à¨¸à¨Ÿà©à¨°à¨¾à¨ˆà¨• à¨°à©‡à¨Ÿ à¨•à©€ à¨¹à©ˆ?
query: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    MIN(bowl_stats.bowling_average) AS best_bowling_average,
    bowl_stats.economy_rate,
    bowl_stats.strike_rate
FROM Players p
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        SUM(d.wides + d.noballs) AS extras,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) - SUM(d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS balls_bowled,
        COUNT(d.wicket_type) AS wickets_taken,
        CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) - SUM(d.wides + d.noballs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(d.wicket_type) AS bowling_average,
        CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) - SUM(d.wides + d.noballs) AS FLOAT) / (COUNT(d.delivery_id) / 6.0) AS economy_rate,
        CAST(COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(d.wicket_type) AS strike_rate
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type != ''
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id

question: Among players with over 800 runs and exactly 3 ducks, who has the lower strike rate â€” and by how much?
query: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_in_innings, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_in_innings) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_in_innings = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM InningsStats GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls) AS lowest_strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.total_runs > 800 AND ps.ducks = 3 ORDER BY lowest_strike_rate ASC LIMIT 2;

    p.player_name,
    MIN(batting_stats.strike_rate) AS lowest_strike_rate,
    (SELECT MAX(batting_stats.strike_rate) 
     FROM (

             d.striker_id,
             SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
             COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS ducks,
             CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS strike_rate
         FROM Deliveries d
         GROUP BY d.striker_id
     ) AS batting_stats
     INNER JOIN Players p ON batting_stats.striker_id = p.player_id
     WHERE batting_stats.total_runs > 800 AND batting_stats.ducks = 3
    ) - MIN(batting_stats.strike_rate) AS difference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS ducks,

) AS batting_stats
INNER JOIN Players p ON batting_stats.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE batting_stats.total_runs > 800 AND batting_stats.ducks = 3;

query: WITH ShortestMatches AS (SELECT match_id FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC LIMIT 15), MatchTeams AS (SELECT m.match_id, m.team1 AS team, m.match_winner FROM Matches m JOIN ShortestMatches sm ON m.match_id = sm.match_id UNION ALL SELECT m.match_id, m.team2 AS team, m.match_winner FROM Matches m JOIN ShortestMatches sm ON m.match_id = sm.match_id) SELECT team, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner != team AND match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aggregate_losses FROM MatchTeams GROUP BY team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY aggregate_losses DESC LIMIT 1;

    m.match_winner IS NOT NULL

        SELECT 
            d.match_id
        FROM 
            Deliveries d
        GROUP BY

        ORDER BY

    )
GROUP BY

    total_losses DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20I history, which player has the most sixes among all players with 30+ fifty-plus scores , average, and ducks?
query: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;

FROM Players p
JOIN (
    SELECT d.striker_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM (

            FROM Deliveries d2

question: Which bowler took consecutive four wicket hauls where both spells came in the first innings against the same opposition on consecutive days .Report his country, ratio of wickets to runs conceded, and opponents?
query: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;

    m1.team2 AS opponents

    JOIN Matches m2 ON m1.team1 = m2.team1 AND m1.team2 = m2.team2

query: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;

generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.batting_team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score,
    d.bowling_team AS opponent_team,
    MAX(d.over_number) + (MAX(d.ball_number) / 6.0) AS overs_played,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS FLOAT) / (MAX(d.over_number) + (MAX(d.ball_number) / 6.0)) AS run_rate
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team
ORDER BY total_score ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Turkey suffered three extremely low T20I totals at the same venue on three consecutive days â€” name all three opponents, scores, innings numbers, and dates?
query: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opponents, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS scores, d.inning AS innings_numbers, m.match_date AS dates FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Turkey' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_date ORDER BY scores ASC LIMIT 3;

    CASE 
        WHEN m.team1 = 'Turkey' THEN m.team2 
        ELSE m.team1 
    END AS opponent,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score,
    d.inning,
    m.match_date
FROM Matches m
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id

    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type != ''
) d
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        bowler_id,
        MIN(match_count) AS fifty_wickets_in_matches
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            d.bowler_id,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.bowler_id ORDER BY m.match_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS match_count,
            m.match_date
        FROM Deliveries d
        JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
        WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type != ''
    )
    WHERE match_count >= 50
    GROUP BY bowler_id
) fifty ON d.bowler_id = fifty.bowler_id AND d.match_count = fifty.fifty_wickets_in_matches
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS first_match_date
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type != ''
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id
) first_match ON d.bowler_id = first_match.bowler_id
ORDER BY d.match_count ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Australia scored 197/7 with 3 stumpings and still won . Name the opposition, venue, date, and calculate what percentage of their wickets were stumpings?

        WHEN m.team1 = 'Australia' THEN m.team2

query: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;

query: WITH PlayerDebut AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(match_date) as debut_date FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY player_id), DebutMatches AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.match_id, pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN PlayerDebut pd ON pim.player_id = pd.player_id AND m.match_date = pd.debut_date) SELECT p.player_name, dm.team_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score FROM Deliveries d JOIN DebutMatches dm ON d.striker_id = dm.player_id AND d.match_id = dm.match_id JOIN Players p ON dm.player_id = p.player_id WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, p.player_name, dm.team_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 70 LIMIT 5;

FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 2
  AND d.striker_id IN (
    SELECT pim.player_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id

question: T20I à¨‡à¨¤à¨¿à¨¹à¨¾à¨¸ à¨µà¨¿à©±à¨š à¨šà©‹à¨Ÿà©€ à¨¦à©‡ 5 à¨°à¨¨ à¨¬à¨£à¨¾à¨‰à¨£ à¨µà¨¾à¨²à¨¿à¨†à¨‚ à¨²à¨ˆ, à¨¹à¨°à©‡à¨• à¨¦à©€ à¨¸à¨Ÿà©à¨°à¨¾à¨ˆà¨• à¨°à©‡à¨Ÿ à¨…à¨¤à©‡ à¨”à¨¸à¨¤ à¨°à¨¨ à¨ªà©à¨°à¨¤à©€ à¨ªà¨¾à¨°à©€ à¨¦à©±à¨¸à©‹, à¨…à¨¤à©‡ à¨‰à¨¨à©à¨¹à¨¾à¨‚ à¨¨à©‚à©° à¨¬à©±à¨²à©‡à¨¬à¨¾à¨œà¨¼à©€ à¨”à¨¸à¨¤ à¨…à¨¨à©à¨¸à¨¾à¨° à¨¦à¨°à¨œà¨¾à¨¬à©°à¨¦à©€ à¨•à¨°à©‹?
query: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN 1 END) * 100 AS strike_rate,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS average
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    average DESC

question: Among the top 5 run-scorers in T20I history, give the strike rate , the average runs per innings for each, and rank them by batting average.
query: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

        d.striker_id,

question: List the top 5 players by catches per innings ratio also give the respective ratios.

query: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;

JOIN

query: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;

    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS player_score
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

      AND d.inning = 2
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
),
MaxLosingSecondInnings AS (
    SELECT MAX(player_score) AS max_score
    FROM LosingTeamSecondInnings
),

question: Which player scored the highest runs on the losing side while batting in 2 innings, and what was the difference between their score and the highest single-innings losing score in the entire table?
query: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;

),

),

        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) as innings_score
    FROM Deliveries d

    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

query: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

FROM (
    SELECT d1.match_id, d1.inning, d1.striker_id, d1.non_striker_id, SUM(d1.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d1.match_id, d1.inning ORDER BY SUM(d1.runs_scored) DESC) AS wicket

) AS partnerships

query: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: In T20Is, how many times has a team scored 220+ when the opposition used only five bowlers and still lost the match? Return the teams, scores, and oppositions.
query: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    m.batting_team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score,
    m.bowling_team AS opposition
FROM 
    Matches m
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    m.match_winner = m.bowling_team
    AND m.bowling_team IN (
        SELECT 
            bowling_team
        FROM 
            Deliveries
        WHERE 
            match_id = m.match_id
        GROUP BY 
            bowling_team, bowler_id
        HAVING 
            COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) = 5
    )
GROUP BY 
    m.match_id, m.batting_team, m.bowling_team
HAVING 
    total_score >= 220;

question: Which Pakistan bowlers took the fewest matches to reach 50 T20I wickets?
query: WITH bowler_match_wickets AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_in_match FROM Deliveries d JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.bowler_id = pim.player_id AND d.match_id = pim.match_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT bowler_id, match_id, wickets_in_match, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_id) AS match_seq, SUM(wickets_in_match) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_wickets FROM bowler_match_wickets ), milestone AS ( SELECT bowler_id, MIN(match_seq) AS matches_to_50 FROM ranked WHERE cum_wickets >= 50 GROUP BY bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, m.matches_to_50 FROM milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.bowler_id = p.player_id ORDER BY m.matches_to_50 LIMIT 10;

    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type != 'run out'
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id, m.match_id, d.inning
),
BowlerInnings AS (
    SELECT
        pim.player_id,
        pim.match_id,
        m.match_date,
        m.season,
        pim.team_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pim.player_id ORDER BY m.match_date) as seq_num
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE pim.team_name IN (
        'Afghanistan', 'Australia', 'Bangladesh', 'England', 'India', 'Ireland', 'New Zealand',
        'Pakistan', 'South Africa', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Zimbabwe'
    )
),
BowlerWicketInnings AS (
    SELECT
        bi.player_id,
        bi.match_id,
        bi.match_date,
        bi.season,
        bi.team_name,
        bi.seq_num,
        COALESCE(wi.wickets, 0) AS wickets
    FROM BowlerInnings bi
    LEFT JOIN WicketInnings wi ON bi.player_id = wi.bowler_id AND bi.match_id = wi.match_id
),
ConsecutiveWicketInnings AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        match_date,
        season,
        team_name,
        seq_num,
        wickets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wickets > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY seq_num) AS grp
    FROM BowlerWicketInnings
),
Streaks AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS consecutive_innings_with_wicket
    FROM ConsecutiveWicketInnings
    WHERE wickets > 0
    GROUP BY player_id, grp
)
SELECT
    p.player_name
FROM Streaks s
JOIN Players p ON s.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY s.consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC
LIMIT 1;

query: WITH wc_teams AS ( SELECT m.match_winner AS team, m.match_date, m.match_id, 1 AS won FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END, m.match_date, m.match_id, 0 FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' ), numbered AS ( SELECT team, match_date, match_id, won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn FROM wc_teams ), grouped AS ( SELECT team, won, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, won ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT team, won, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE won = 1 GROUP BY team, won, grp ) SELECT team, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_wins FROM streaks GROUP BY team ORDER BY max_consecutive_wins DESC LIMIT 10;

        SELECT

            match_date,
            match_winner,
            result_type,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date) -
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY match_date) AS grp

question: What are the most consecutive wins in Menâ€™s T20 World Cups?
query: WITH wc_teams AS ( SELECT m.match_winner AS team, m.match_date, m.match_id, 1 AS won FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END, m.match_date, m.match_id, 0 FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' ), numbered AS ( SELECT team, match_date, match_id, won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn FROM wc_teams ), grouped AS ( SELECT team, won, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, won ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT team, won, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE won = 1 GROUP BY team, won, grp ) SELECT team, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_wins FROM streaks GROUP BY team ORDER BY max_consecutive_wins DESC LIMIT 10;

    SELECT 
        match_id,
        match_date,
        team1,
        team2,
        match_winner,
        result_type
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage != 'Group' AND result_type = 'wickets' AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
TeamWins AS (
    SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_date, 
           CASE WHEN team1 = match_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
    FROM MatchResults
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_date, 
           CASE WHEN team2 = match_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
    FROM MatchResults
),

    SELECT team, match_id, match_date, win,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date) AS rn
    FROM TeamWins
),

           rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, win ORDER BY match_date) AS grp
    FROM SortedTeamWins
    WHERE win = 1
),

    FROM WinGroups

query: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), cumulative AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM Deliveries d JOIN knockout_cte kc ON d.match_id = kc.match_id ), first_100 AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, MIN(over_number) AS over_when_100, MIN(ball_number) AS ball_when_100 FROM cumulative WHERE running_total >= 100 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team ) SELECT f.batting_team, f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM first_100 f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE f.batting_team IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100 LIMIT 10;

FROM

question: Who has the most consecutive 50+ scores in T20 World Cups?
query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerScores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
),
Consecutive50s AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.striker_id,
        ps.match_id,
        ps.runs,
        CASE 
            WHEN ps.runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS scored_50,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ps.runs < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.striker_id ORDER BY m.match_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp
    FROM PlayerScores ps
    JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id
),
Streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        grp,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_length
    FROM Consecutive50s
    WHERE scored_50 = 1
    GROUP BY striker_id, grp
),
MaxStreaks AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        MAX(streak_length) AS max_streak
    FROM Streaks
    GROUP BY striker_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM MaxStreaks ms
JOIN Players p ON ms.striker_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY ms.max_streak DESC
LIMIT 1;
